recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, black-and-white close-up portrait of a bearded man with feathered hair, featuring dramatic side-lighting that casts half the face in deep shadow. The composition is tight, focusing on the eyes, and includes a diagonal script title in the upper left and a rectangular purple promotional sticker in the upper right.
coreVisualRelationships: The diagonal tilt of the script text mirrors the angle of the subject's gaze.
The deep black shadows of the beard and hair anchor the bottom and sides of the frame.
The purple sticker provides a singular point of chromatic contrast against the grayscale image.
The grain texture of the film unifies the photographic and typographic elements.
coreInvariants: High-contrast monochrome palette for the main image
Tight facial cropping with the eyes on the upper horizontal third line
Presence of a secondary color block (sticker) for metadata

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up, centered horizontally, with the face filling approximately 80% of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's right eye (viewer's left), which is the sharpest point of focus.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the script title in the top left, moves down the bridge of the nose to the eyes, and ends at the purple sticker in the top right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; limited to the small gray areas around the hair and the deep black of the clothing at the bottom.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Grayscale (Black, White, Mid-tone Gray) for the photographic subject.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Black for shadow depth and structural definition.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Plum/Purple for the promotional sticker element.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the portrait; low saturation in the accent color to maintain a vintage feel.
paletteRestrictions: No sepia tones; stick to neutral grays

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Casual brush script and geometric sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Script: 30-degree upward slant, connected lowercase, high stroke contrast.
Sans-serif: All-caps, heavy weight, tight kerning, low x-height.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'M' in the script has an elongated initial stroke that leads the eye into the name.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between organic, fluid script and rigid, geometric sans-serif.

preserve: Diagonal orientation of the main title
The specific plum-purple color of the sticker

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the dense, impactful sans-serif on the sticker.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white close-up portrait of a man with a thick beard and feathered 80s hair. Use chiascurro lighting with one side of the face in shadow. Apply a heavy film grain texture.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a white script title in the top left corner at a 15-degree upward angle. In the top right, add a small plum-colored rectangular sticker with white all-caps sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the script text tilted upwards?
Is the purple sticker present in the top right?
Is the grain texture visible across the image?

mustRedesign: Avoid using the specific artist name or song titles from the original
Ensure the face is a generic model to avoid likeness issues
postGenerationChecks: Check that the text is legible against the hair texture.
Ensure the sticker does not obscure the eyes.
Verify the black levels are deep and not washed out.
Confirm the script font feels hand-drawn rather than mechanical.
recipe.reuseFormula: Monochrome Portrait + Diagonal Script + Color-Block Metadata Sticker = 80s Soft Rock Aesthetic
